# ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops Daily Update (Mar 26, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's focus was on updating task statuses for Arena-Z Sepolia and addressing several L2CM upgrade-related issues. Discussions also continued on a flaky test and a new issue regarding `StorageKeys` value in `op-geth`.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Sepolia Task Status Updates
The status of Arena-Z Sepolia tasks, specifically proposer rotation and fee vault updates, was marked as executed. ([#1390](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1390))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
No new pull requests were opened today.

## CLOSED ISSUES

### L2CM Upgrade Tooling Enhancements
Several issues related to L2 Contract Manager (L2CM) upgrades were closed, including the creation of a Solidity script for deterministic JSON NUT bundle generation ([#18834](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18834)), implementation of dev feature flag support ([#18838](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18838)), and the addition of `just` commands for generating NUT bundles ([#18840](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18840)) and running L2 upgrade fork tests ([#18841](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18841)).

### Flaky Test Resolution
A flaky test related to `TestCLELDivergence` was closed, with discussions indicating a fix was implemented in a related pull request. ([#19681](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19681))

## NEW ISSUES

### `op-geth` `StorageKeys` Value Change
A new issue was reported concerning a breaking change in `op-geth` v1.101701.0, where the `StorageKeys` value is now `null` instead of `[]`. This is attributed to the `SortedFunc` in Go returning `nil` for empty slices. ([#780](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/780))

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### Flaky Test: `TestPreinteropFaultProofs_TraceExtensionActivation` ([#19760](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19760))
Discussion centered on a flaky test related to `TestPreinteropFaultProofs_TraceExtensionActivation`. Ajsutton provided a detailed explanation of the root cause, identifying a nonce race condition during the `migrateSuperRoots` process due to different transaction-sending mechanisms. It was noted that a pending PR ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#19745](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19745)) is expected to fix this by simplifying the migration process and avoiding ownership reassignments, thereby eliminating the race condition.

### Contracts: Prove withdrawals using chain-specific root claim ([#18517](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18517))
Ajsutton inquired about closing this issue, suggesting that the approach might have changed to use `rootClaimByChainId` based on the game type. This implies that the original goal of ensuring `OptimismPortal2.proveWithdrawalTransaction` uses `IDisputeGame.rootClaim(uint256)` might have been addressed through an alternative implementation.

### [L2CM] Investigate adding an array of predeploys to increase upgrade safety ([#19260](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19260))
Maurelian provided an in-depth analysis of a structural pipeline gap in the L2CM upgrade process, where `L2DevFeatureFlags` was initially omitted from the NUT bundle's deployment. While a fix has been merged ([#19464](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19464)), the discussion highlighted that the underlying issue of decentralized implementation knowledge across multiple data structures remains. The analysis also pointed out a latent `ConditionalDeployer` issue that could lead to a worse failure mode in future upgrades if not addressed.

### Document interop tx pool eviction behavior on reorg ([#19351](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19351))
Pcw109550 raised a question regarding the behavior of interop transactions in the mempool during a reorg, specifically whether the mempool explicitly iterates and drops interop transactions or if periodic re-evaluation handles this. This follows a change in `op-geth` ([op-geth#772](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/772)) to drop interop executing messages on any reorg.

### Remove Karst-specific upgrade transactions from GenerateNUTBundle ([#19369](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19369))
0xOneTony provided a detailed comment outlining the necessary updates to `UpgradeUtils.getTransactionCount()` and the `GasLimits` struct when removing the Karst-specific upgrade transactions. This includes adjusting the transaction count and removing Karst-only fields to ensure consistency after the Karst upgrade is deployed to all networks.
